description: Curated navigation smoke questions about this repository's actual implementation. These are not collected user queries or an independent quality benchmark. Replace them with real questions from your own workflow.

Fuse keyword symbol and vector ranks using reciprocal rank fusion
Extract SQL reads writes and procedure executions from T-SQL text
Cache the historical index of a Git revision for impact analysis
Apply mean or CLS pooling and normalize ONNX transformer embeddings
Validate evaluation questions and reject empty relevant answers or duplicate IDs
Split camelCase and snake_case identifiers into lowercase words
Reload changed project synonym configuration using a content fingerprint

Migrate older SQLite symbol tables by adding missing columns
